===== connected_components_3d =====
def connected_components_3d(mask: np.ndarray):
    from scipy import ndimage
    lab, n = ndimage.label(mask.astype(bool))
    objs = ndimage.find_objects(lab)
    comps = []
    for i, sl in enumerate(objs, start=1):
        if sl is None:
            continue
        vox = int((lab[sl] == i).sum())
        z0, z1 = sl[0].start, sl[0].stop
        y0, y1 = sl[1].start, sl[1].stop
        x0, x1 = sl[2].start, sl[2].stop
        comps.append({"label": i, "voxels": vox, "bbox": (z0, z1, y0, y1, x0, x1), "z_slices": z1 - z0})
    return lab, comps


===== filter_components_by_prob =====
def filter_components_by_prob(
    mask_bool: np.ndarray,
    prob: np.ndarray,
    min_voxels: int = 1,
    min_z_slices: int = 1,
    min_area_px: int = 0,
    min_component_max_prob: float = 0.0,
    keep_topk: int = 0,
) -> np.ndarray:
    pred = np.asarray(mask_bool).astype(bool)
    if not pred.any():
        return pred
    lab, comps = connected_components_3d(pred)
    kept: List[Tuple[int, int, float]] = []
    for c in comps:
        label = int(c["label"])
        voxels = int(c["voxels"])
        z0, z1, y0, y1, x0, x1 = c["bbox"]
        z_slices = int(np.any((lab[z0:z1] == label).reshape(z1 - z0, -1), axis=1).sum())
        max_area = 0
        for z in range(z0, z1):
            max_area = max(max_area, int((lab[z] == label).sum()))
        comp_prob_max = float(prob[lab == label].max()) if np.any(lab == label) else 0.0
        if voxels < int(min_voxels):
            continue
        if z_slices < int(min_z_slices):
            continue
        if int(min_area_px) > 0 and max_area < int(min_area_px):
            continue
        if comp_prob_max < float(min_component_max_prob):
            continue
        kept.append((label, voxels, comp_prob_max))

    if int(keep_topk) > 0 and len(kept) > int(keep_topk):
        kept = sorted(kept, key=lambda x: (x[2], x[1]), reverse=True)[: int(keep_topk)]
    if not kept:
        return np.zeros_like(pred, dtype=bool)
    keep_labels = {x[0] for x in kept}
    return np.isin(lab, list(keep_labels))
